_about: Crashes we understand, read by tools/crash_watch.js. match: a substring of a frame in the top 8 of the crashed thread. fixedIn: the first build that carries the fix (CalVer). The same crash on an older build is expected and stays quiet; on fixedIn or later it is a regression and notifies.

signatures.title: iOS 27 stops an app that has not adopted the UIScene lifecycle
signatures.why: Built with the iOS 27 SDK and no UIApplicationSceneManifest, UIKit traps at launch (EXC_BREAKPOINT). The Capacitor 8.4 template has no scene delegate.
signatures.fix: tools/cap_ios_configure.rb step 6 (SceneDelegate.swift + scene manifest), gated by tools/ios_launch_smoke.sh
